title: Fatima Prayer (O My Jesus)
text:
O my Jesus, forgive us our sins,
save us from the fires of hell,
and lead all souls to heaven,
especially those most in need of Thy mercy.
notes: The decade prayer prayed after each Glory Be. Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Domine Iesu, dimitte nobis debita nostra, salva nos ab igne inferni, perduc in caelum omnes animas, praesertim eas, quae misericordiae tuae maxime indigent.
